about.title: About me
about.bio1: Hi, I'm Jeffrey Rodríguez, a Visual Communicator Senior with 20+ years of experience across advertising, graphic and web design, front-end development and photography.
about.bio2: I've worked as senior visual designer, art director, interactive designer and front-end developer, from newspapers and magazines to animated HTML5 ads, email design and social media content.
about.bio3: I want to keep growing personally and professionally, apply everything I've learned, and be an important part of the teams I join. I speak Spanish, English and intermediate French.
